newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, dealers said on Thursday.

They said prices in Tokyo and Kobe were mostly firmer and trapped within tight ranges as the yen's weaker tendency against the U.S. dollar was offset by easier demand in rubber-producing countries ahead of the Chinese New Year.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives, with lack of Chinese enquiries and quiet ring sessions limiting activity," a local broker said.

"(Local) prices were marked down slightly in the afternoon as some speculative selling interest emerged. Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were marked up slightly today but there was no follow-through buying interst here. Volume was moderate," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, March RSS3 fell 1.50 cents to 117.25 U.S. cents a kg.
April RSS1 fell 2.75 cents to 167.25 Singapore cents (US$1.19) a kg.
April TSR20 fell 1.50 cents to 165.25 Singapore cents (US$1.18) a kg. (US$1-S$1.40) - P.Theseira (65-870-3085)
